claims.text: The driver never entered the pickup geofence. His own trace places him 559.37 m from the pin at his closest approach (driver_track.min_distance_m), more than eleven times the 50 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for a STANDARD zone, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 — not one of his 37 fixes falls inside the radius. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and the fee is not chargeable.

Independently of the geofence, the driver's dwell was zero. derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires for a STANDARD pickup, so the waiting clock never started and no dwell had elapsed when the driver cancelled at 07:31:00. Limb (c) fails on its own and the conjunctive four-limb test in POL-NS-01 collapses.

POL-NS-06 states the arithmetic directly: an effective in-geofence dwell of 0 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum is a 300 second shortfall, and on that shortfall the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The driver cannot rescue the computation under POL-NS-06(i), because there are no separate in-geofence intervals to accumulate and no traffic advisory on file.

The 07:25:20 'arrived' marker is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. At that timestamp the trace places the driver 559.37 m from the pin — far beyond the 300 m threshold — and his distinct speed is 0.0 km/h at a fixed standoff, so he was stationary, but not at the pickup. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies squarely: the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

POL-NS-03 cannot be used to soften this into a wrong-entrance case. That clause reaches only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; the driver's closest fix was 559.37 m out, past the 400 m ceiling, so the clause does not engage at all. No venue-identity comparison is needed and no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road and waiting window. EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so its absence is itself citable: there is no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT on file, and nothing in the record explains the driver's 559 m standoff from the pickup point as a lawful reason to hold off the kerb.

The chat log does not place the car at the block. Its only driver message, at 07:25:40, is 'I have marked arrival.' — an assertion about the app marker, not about the vehicle's position — and the system's 'Your driver has arrived' notice at 07:25:21 merely repeats the same marker. Nothing in the record contradicts the rider's account that the car never came to the block, and the trace shows why: the driver was 559 m away the whole time.

No driver compensation is payable on these facts. POL-NS-07 funds compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, while POL-NS-05(ii) says in terms that no compensation is payable where there is no qualifying in-geofence fix. On the profile side, driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the threshold POL-NS-07 names, so the anti-farming question does not arise.

This case does not rest on impaired evidence, so confidence in a full refund is not capped. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, covers 100% of the window with 37 fixes at a 10 second cadence, carries no gaps (max gap 0 seconds), and the 07:25:20 arrival marker coincides exactly with a GPS fix timestamp, so there is no clock skew to discount the arrival finding under POL-GEN-02.

The money is fixed by the ledger: fare_breakdown shows a SGD 4.00 cancellation fee actually charged, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, against a SGD 0.00 base fare on a trip that never started. A full refund of that cancellation-fee line is the remedy, and it leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge.

claims.text: The rider's exonerating route under POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a). The chat log carries exactly two messages and neither was sent by the rider: MSG-09104-001 is the SYSTEM 'Your driver has arrived' notice at 07:25:21 and MSG-09104-002 is the driver's own 'I have marked arrival.' at 07:25:40. There is no rider message giving her own position, naming an entrance, block, tower or bay, asking where the driver is, or saying she cannot see the vehicle - so the coordinating message limb (a) requires simply does not exist in this window.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) also fails, and on the rider's own device. The rider track runs from 07:25:30 to 07:30:50 and places her 519.46 m from the pickup pin, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against a rider presence radius of 100 m for the STANDARD zone class. The rider was not waiting at the pickup point either, so her account that the car 'never came to my block' is not corroborated by her own trace.

The driver's record carries no anti-farming pattern on the two fields POL-NS-07 names and no others: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, short of the '4 or more' limb, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008, short of the 0.08 limb. Because POL-NS-07 requires both limbs, its anti-farming branch does not trip on this driver, compensation is not withheld on that ground, and the escalation packet that branch prescribes - the one that directs the reviewer to refund the rider in full - is not engaged.

No abuse-based escalation trigger is available on the counters the policy actually reads. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so neither limb (c) nor limb (d) of POL-NS-09 fires, and the lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be substituted for them. This case falls to be decided on this trip's own evidence, not on either party's history.

The arrival event on this trip is not a bare, uncorroborated tap. The trip record records arrived_at 07:25:20 and a wait_time_min of 5.7 running to the 07:31:00 cancellation; the platform's own SYSTEM notification 'Your driver has arrived' went out at 07:25:21; the driver posted 'I have marked arrival.' at 07:25:40; and his statement on file is that he 'marked arrival and waited before cancelling'. The trace, for its part, places the driver 559.37 m from the pin across the same interval. The driver did not leave and return - there are no gaps, max_gap_sec is 0.0 and trace_distance_km is 0.0 - so this is not a driver who took another job and came back. If the Judge finds these admissible artifacts in direct conflict over arrival and dwell, POL-NS-09(b) applies: the open question of which measure governs is for a human reviewer, and the SGD 4.00 fee is held rather than refunded while that review is pending.

ruling.explanation:
For the rider: your claim is supported and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full. The platform GPS trace for trip TRP-09104 (EV-GPS-09104) places the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at Blk 180 Bukit Panjang Ring Rd — a STANDARD zone with a 50 m arrival radius — at 559.37 m, more than eleven times the radius, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0: not one of his 37 fixes falls inside the geofence. The driver's 'arrived' tap at 07:25:20 is therefore a FALSE arrival marker under POL-NS-05, because at that timestamp the trace puts him 559.37 m from the pin, well past the 300 m threshold, and his distinct speed is 0.0 km/h, i.e. he was stationary — but not at your block. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies squarely: the fee is refunded in full and no compensation is payable. The same result follows independently under POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation). POL-NS-01 fails on two limbs — limb (b), because the driver was never inside the geofence, and limb (c), because the in-geofence dwell was 0 seconds against the 300 second minimum — so the conjunctive four-limb test collapses. POL-NS-03 does not soften this into a wrong-entrance case: its 400 m ceiling is not met (559.37 m), so no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

For the driver: your statement that you marked arrival and waited is noted, but a status a party sets records only that the party set it. POL-NS-01 measures the waiting clock from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the 'arrived' tap, and the trace places you 559.37 m away throughout with zero in-geofence fixes and zero dwell; the trip record's wait_time_min of 5.7 cannot override that. Your advocate's argument that POL-NS-09(b) applies — a direct conflict between the trip record and the trace — is rejected: POL-NS-05 is precisely the clause that resolves a marker set while the driver is beyond 300 m, so there is no unresolved contradiction and no escalation. Your POL-NS-04 arguments are accepted as far as they go (the chat log contains no rider coordinating message, and the rider's own track places her 519.46 m from the pin), but they do not make the fee chargeable: POL-NS-04 is an exonerating route for the rider whose failure leaves POL-NS-01 to decide, and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails regardless. Your POL-NS-07 anti-farming point also holds — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and the 30-day rate is 0.008, so the anti-farming branch does not trip and no escalation arises from it — but because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, no compensation is payable to you either.

Confidence is 0.90. The deciding facts — the driver's distance from the pin and the absence of any qualifying in-geofence fix — are carried by EV-GPS-09104 and EV-TRIP-09104, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the trace covers 100% of the window at a 10 second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): there is no clock skew (the 07:25:20 marker coincides with a fix), no sampling gap, no chat truncation (2 messages against chat_message_count 2), and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the fee schedule (STANDARD 4.00, RYDE_X 4.00), so the escalation floor is not engaged. The traffic advisory file EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; its absence means POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to accumulate dwell across intervals, but nothing turns on that here because there are no in-geofence intervals to accumulate. One referral is required by clause: POL-NS-05(ii) records the false-arrival event against the driver.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-09104 on trip TRP-09104 — the driver's 07:25:20 'arrived' marker was set 559.37 m from the pickup pin (beyond the 300 m threshold) and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
